name: hxn-gpu-webgl2
description: WebGL2 for Haxe in the browser, on hxcpp and Ash compiled to wasm: buffers, textures, samplers, programs, vertex arrays and framebuffers
releasenote: First release: WebGL2 in the browser, for hxcpp programs compiled to wasm with or without threads and for threaded Ash programs: a context on the web page's canvas, buffers, textures, samplers, programs from hxnsl's GLSL ES 3.00 with their binding points and texture units, vertex arrays, framebuffers, and a future for the GPU finishing.
